request.style: English, Celtic sea-shanty folk, rugged male vocal with crew-style group chorus, fiddle, accordion, bodhran, bouzouki, rolling 6/8 swing, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We rowed out on the dark lake when the stars were in the sky
We cast and hauled the empty nets till the morning sun came high
We were washing out the tackle when the Teacher came along
He climbed into my boat and said, now push us out from shore

[Chorus]
Put out into deep water
And let down your nets for a catch
Master, we worked hard all night and caught nothing
But at your word I will let down the nets

[Verse]
The nets began to tear, boys, the fish came leaping in
We signaled to our partners, they came rowing to the din
We filled both boats so full of fish that they began to sink
And I fell down before him and I couldn't even think

[Chorus]
Put out into deep water
And let down your nets for a catch
Master, we worked hard all night and caught nothing
But at your word I will let down the nets

[Bridge]
Go away from me, Lord, for I am a sinful man
Do not be afraid
From now on you will be catching people
So they brought their boats to shore, left everything behind
And followed him

[Outro]
At your word I will let down the nets
